notes.title: JUKEBOX UPDATE
notes.content:
I thought for a while that I should also make a Jukebox for Dark Asteroids. After all, Lukas was very successful with the music and it is very nice to be able to play individual songs from the game. At least I like it. 

Clicking on the icon an individual song will play only one song endlessly. Or clicking on the "Play All" icon will infinitely play all the songs from the game in nice sequential order. 
I wish you a pleasant listening.

What's next? In my head is ripe with ideas for the next game from the Dark Asteroids world. The only thing I will reveal for now is that it will take place before the events of Dark Asteroids. 

If you want to play another game of mine, here's one I made during the GAMEHIGHED Jam 2021 competition in 48 hours. It's called Dark Care Jam21. Download the game for free here. https://darkbeast.itch.io/dark-care-jam21

Or here is my second game Dark Blocks - completely finished, including two DLCs. Have fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38868489/be7ad227d1147c026ca3459d6df97bec9af610a9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Enemy Gates Update
notes.content:
In the original version of Dark Asteroids, the enemy gates were not revealed until several weeks later. It is now earlier for the individual missions to be better interspersed and for an even better gaming experience. For this reason, I also added one new mission with a gate. During the testing, I learned how the change significantly contributes to the gaming experience.

I also enriched the lyrics in the final attack on the enemy Observatory and Factory.

I added an icon to the base with the option to turn on / off the summary of the completed mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38868489/33c76d234e893b9f46e32d341b4c199cd2d787b5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.content:
It's a big moment. Now I am fully satisfied with the game Dark Asteroids. It contains everything I intended, and I believe that you will spend wonderful game moments with it. 

Well, it's not amazing to do that on Friday the 13th. :-)

notes.title: RELEASE DATE NOVEMBER 5, 2020
notes.content:
Here it is. America told me that Dark Asteroids is fine and may be released on Steam next week on [b]Thursday, November 5, 2020[/b].
